services.desc: Come with me as we look through the world of helicopters and what they can do. Each day will bring new ideas and insightful looks at the wonderful and exciting aircraft “The Helicopter”. Let’s start the journey into Helicopters and what they can do. Become one of the newest Rotorwing pilots. Come back as often as you like. We will have new content and new things from the World of Helicopters. Good evening to you

blurb: WR Bar Helicopters offers helicopter flight training services including IFR currency maintenance, turbine transition, ground instruction, check ride preparation, VFR recovery from IMC, and familiarization flights to build time or comfort. They provide simulator time with an MH350 by Elite and aerial services using a DJI Phantom 3 Professional drone.
